data: Is the dashed red line representing 'dist' consistently higher than the solid black line representing 'baseline'?

The dashed red line representing 'dist' is not consistently higher than the solid black line representing 'baseline'. The 'dist' line fluctuates above and below the 'baseline' line throughout the range of topics. At some points, the 'baseline' line is above the 'dist' line, indicating that the average topic distance between the training half and validation half for the black interviewer dataset is lower than the average topic distance between the training half of the black interviewer dataset and the white interviewer dataset.
